native_ids.storage: existing signed SQLite int64 integers; no renumbering or migration
native_ids.browser_api: canonical positive decimal strings, 1..9223372036854775807; no leading zero, sign, whitespace, exponent, decimal point or non-ASCII digit
native_ids.requests: strings are validated and converted to Python integers before the existing Go stdio int64 codec
native_ids.legacy_numbers: only exact JSON integers 1..9007199254740991 accepted; unsafe integers, all floats and booleans rejected before native access
native_ids.responses: Read115 and known native character/account/history ID fields converted to strings before browser JSON
native_ids.pending: new durable requests store string IDs; old pending integer IDs exposed as strings without rewriting the original file; exact native replay preserved
native_ids.ui: account/role selects and ownership comparison keep strings; no Number/parseInt coercion for native IDs

uid_separation.platform_uid8: separate existing format validator: exactly eight ASCII digits as a string, preserve leading zero; format is not authentication or allocation permission
uid_separation.universal_local_uid: format/namespace governed by DB+host candidate contract; never infer from native ID or username, never apply platform UID8 format implicitly

account_storage_requirement.source: 2026-10-16 user: explicit optional external account/UID storage, otherwise native SQLite
account_storage_requirement.owner_contract_status: configuration validator tested; real external adapter not implemented
account_storage_requirement.configuration: server-only explicit sqlite or external; sqlite default only without external fields; external credentials protected on server with TLS verification; failures fail closed
account_storage_requirement.gm: consume future authenticated management status/mapping DTO, no direct SQL credentials, no invented ready state or UID mapping
account_storage_requirement.transactions: external canonical account+UID and native SQLite are separate resources; durable pending operation, host idempotent receipt and exact verified mapping before activation; no name adoption or destructive compensation
account_storage_requirement.policy_override_scope: user authorization covers optional account/UID adapter only; no character/inventory migration, no Postgres revival or broader SQLite-only policy bypass
account_storage_requirement.latest_identity_schema_note: DB r1 predates newest login_id/nickname semantics; owner revision is required before treating it as frozen identity schema. GM native-key boundary only.

latest_user_identity_definition.login_id: user-facing id, ASCII letters/digits, required at registration; central proposed length4..32 pending shared schema
latest_user_identity_definition.uid: independently allocated, not native key or nickname
latest_user_identity_definition.username: display nickname only, default login_id snapshot if omitted; nickname change does not alter identity/bindings
latest_user_identity_definition.native_accounts_id: existing integer relation key retained; GM calls it internal account key, never rewrites it as a string column
latest_user_identity_definition.authentication: GM implements no game account login/registration; future auth permits explicit login_id/UID/verified email/phone/bound provider subject only, numeric login_id-vs-UID must be explicit or reject
latest_user_identity_definition.compatibility: native username label is not used by GM as authentication, UID mapping, or name-based adoption; public nickname/login-ID privacy remains owner schema/API work

immutability.player: login_id/UID immutable after registration; registration notice and player API allowlists owned by website/host
immutability.nickname: username display nickname may change without changing identity or mapping
immutability.admin: not enabled; require independent administrative identity, revision/idempotency, uniqueness/reservation checks, audit, epoch/session/assertion/cache revocation
immutability.receipts: 008 provisioning and009 issue/consume receipts are immutable; no UPDATE of old receipt to match a new UID; reviewed superseding receipt/identity revision is required
immutability.gm_current: no identity editor or fake-success endpoint; RPC identity methods and extra ID/UID/nickname fields in SP/TP rejected
immutability.native_keys: remain integer relation keys; no renumbering, sequence reset or player data mutation

latest_user_identity_definition.player_ui: Actual login_id/UID fields are gray readonly and remain legible/copyable; only nickname editable, one clear registration notice. Do not show protection/rejection jargon in normal player flows; no admin edit button in player account center.
latest_user_identity_definition.gm_ui: GM target selectors are internal native relation keys, not player login_id/UID fields; no canonical identity values are invented from native key/name. No player account center or privileged identity editor implemented here.
